LanguageData.LP_SH_ShadowArts.label: shadow arts
LanguageData.LP_SH_ShadowArts.description: Release magical darkness of radius 3 at a point within 20 cells: enemies inside get sight -50% for 10 seconds × martial power. Passive: while standing in darkness, your own sight +30% and unaffected by magical darkness. Ki 2, cooldown 20 seconds. Way of Shadow, monk level 3.
LanguageData.LP_SH_ShadowStep.label: shadow step
LanguageData.LP_SH_ShadowStep.description: While standing in darkness, teleport to another visible dark empty cell within 12 cells; for 5 seconds afterwards the next melee hit deals ×1.5 damage with +30% hit. No ki cost, cooldown 10 seconds. Way of Shadow, monk level 6.
LanguageData.LP_SH_Cloak.label: cloak of shadows
LanguageData.LP_SH_Cloak.description: While standing in darkness, become a shadow: invisible until you attack or step into light (30%+ light). No ki cost, cooldown 10 seconds. Way of Shadow, monk level 11.
LanguageData.LP_SH_Opportunist.label: opportunist
LanguageData.LP_SH_Opportunist.description: Passive: when an enemy right next to you is hit by someone else, you immediately follow up with a melee strike on it (a full melee resolution), once every 2 seconds. Way of Shadow, monk level 17.
LanguageData.LP_OH_Technique.label: open hand technique
LanguageData.LP_OH_Technique.description: Each punch of Flurry of Blows adds an effect; click this button to cycle three: knockdown (70% chance, stun 1.5 seconds), push (70% chance, push 3 cells), disrupt (always works, the target's melee hit -30% for 6 seconds). -5% success per level the target is above you, minimum 10%. No ki cost. Way of the Open Hand, monk level 3.
LanguageData.LP_OH_Wholeness.label: wholeness of body
LanguageData.LP_OH_Wholeness.description: Circulate ki to heal yourself: instantly heal 3 × monk level injury. No ki cost, once per day. Way of the Open Hand, monk level 6.
LanguageData.LP_OH_Tranquility.label: tranquility
LanguageData.LP_OH_Tranquility.description: Passive: every time you wake you carry an aura of peace: each enemy attack has a 50% chance to miss (-5% per level they're above you, minimum 10%). The aura breaks as soon as you attack an enemy, returning the next time you wake. Way of the Open Hand, monk level 11.
LanguageData.LP_OH_Palm.label: quivering palm
LanguageData.LP_OH_Palm.description: Punch a lethal force into an adjacent enemy (a full melee resolution): the force lies latent for monk level days with no effect until you use "detonate quivering palm". Only one person can carry quivering ki at a time. Ki 3, cooldown 10 seconds. Way of the Open Hand, monk level 17.
LanguageData.LP_OH_Detonate.label: detonate quivering palm
LanguageData.LP_OH_Detonate.description: Detonate the enemy on the same map carrying your quivering ki (no need to see them): 50% chance (25% for bosses, -5% per level the target is above you, minimum 10%) to drop them outright; even on failure they take 55 × martial power force damage. No ki cost, cooldown 10 seconds. Way of the Open Hand, monk level 17.
LanguageData.LP_EV_Savant.label: evocation savant
LanguageData.LP_EV_Savant.description: Passive: research speed +20% (studying spell theory). School of Evocation, wizard level 2.
LanguageData.LP_EV_Sculpt.label: sculpt spells (school)
LanguageData.LP_EV_Sculpt.description: Passive: your spell damage (fire, cold, lightning, psychic, arcane force, not from weapons) can't hit allies, so fireball and lightning bolt can be thrown into melee with confidence. Different from the class feat "Spell sculpting" (mana -1, cooldown ×0.85); both can be had at once. School of Evocation, wizard level 2.
LanguageData.LP_EV_Potent.label: potent cantrip
LanguageData.LP_EV_Potent.description: Passive: magic missile (the wizard cantrip) damage ×1.5. School of Evocation, wizard level 6.
LanguageData.LP_EV_Empowered.label: empowered evocation
LanguageData.LP_EV_Empowered.description: Passive: evocation spell (magic missile, fireball, lightning bolt, disintegrate) damage + Intelligence modifier × 10% (Intelligence 16 → +30%). School of Evocation, wizard level 10.
LanguageData.LP_EV_Overchannel.label: overchannel
LanguageData.LP_EV_Overchannel.description: The next evocation spell cast within 10 seconds deals ×2 damage. The first use between each sleep has no cost; each further use deals 26 / 39 / 52... arcane force backlash to yourself after casting (26 for the 2nd, +13 each time after, ignoring resistance). No mana cost, cooldown 10 seconds. School of Evocation, wizard level 14.
LanguageData.LP_SC_Quill.label: wizardly quill
LanguageData.LP_SC_Quill.description: Passive: a magic quill that needs no ink: reading scrolls never fails, research speed +10%. Order of Scribes, wizard level 2.
LanguageData.LP_SC_Tome.label: awakened spellbook
LanguageData.LP_SC_Tome.description: Click the button to switch fireball and lightning bolt damage type: unchanged → fire → cold → lightning → arcane force (for enemies weak to some element, or immune to fire). No mana cost. Order of Scribes, wizard level 2.
LanguageData.LP_SC_Manifest.label: manifest mind
LanguageData.LP_SC_Manifest.description: Manifest the mind of the spellbook for 1 hour: the next 3 wizard spells cost no mana, and enemies within 15 cells can't turn invisible. Once per day. Order of Scribes, wizard level 6.
LanguageData.LP_SC_MasterScrivener.label: master scrivener
LanguageData.LP_SC_MasterScrivener.description: Passive: each time you wake, one more scroll is in your pack (a random one of fireball, true seeing, protection from evil, teleportation), which anyone can read. Order of Scribes, wizard level 10.
LanguageData.LP_SC_OneWord.label: one with the word
LanguageData.LP_SC_OneWord.description: Passive: once between each sleep, when you've lost over half your health, block one hit of 10 or more damage; the cost is losing a random 3-18 mana (down to 0 if not enough). Order of Scribes, wizard level 14.
LanguageData.LP_DM_Disciple.label: draconic disciple
LanguageData.LP_DM_Disciple.description: Passive: draconic strike, unarmed hits add 4 × martial power damage of the chosen element; draconic presence, social impact +15%, negotiation ability +10%. Way of the Ascendant Dragon, monk level 3.
LanguageData.LP_DM_Element.label: draconic strike: element
LanguageData.LP_DM_Element.description: Click the button to switch the dragon's element: fire → cold → lightning → acid → poison. Draconic strike, breath of the dragon and ancient dragon stance all use it. No ki cost. Way of the Ascendant Dragon, monk level 3.
LanguageData.LP_DM_Breath.label: breath of the dragon
LanguageData.LP_DM_Breath.description: Breathe a 6-cell cone of dragon breath in one direction (12 cells from level 17): each enemy takes 12 × martial power damage of the chosen element (18 at level 11, 24 at 17), with a 50% chance to dodge half (+5% dodge chance per level the target is above you). Free 2 + (monk level - 1) ÷ 4 times per day, then 2 ki each time. Cooldown 5 seconds. Way of the Ascendant Dragon, monk level 3.
LanguageData.LP_DM_Wings.label: wings unfurled
LanguageData.LP_DM_Wings.description: Passive: during Step of the Wind, spectral dragon wings unfold on your back, and terrain, snow and plants don't slow you while walking. Way of the Ascendant Dragon, monk level 6.
LanguageData.LP_DM_Aspect.label: ancient dragon stance
LanguageData.LP_DM_Aspect.description: Exude a draconic aura for 1 minute: allies within radius 3 (including yourself) take ×0.5 damage of the chosen element; enemies in the aura have a 50% chance to panic and flee for 10 seconds (-5% per level the target is above you). The first use each day is free, then 3 ki each time. Cooldown 10 seconds. Way of the Ascendant Dragon, monk level 11.
LanguageData.LP_DM_Ascendant.label: ascendant aspect
LanguageData.LP_DM_Ascendant.description: Passive: augmented breath, dragon's breath 12 cells with 24 × martial power damage; blindsight, enemies within 3 cells can't turn invisible; fury burst, during ancient dragon stance each enemy in the aura takes 16 × martial power damage of the chosen element. Way of the Ascendant Dragon, monk level 17.
LanguageData.LP_LD_LandSpell.label: land's spell
LanguageData.LP_LD_LandSpell.description: Cast a different spell based on the map's climate (at a point within 20 cells): cold, frost grip (radius 3, 8 × verdant power freezing, movement ×0.4 for 10 seconds); temperate, grasping roots (radius 3, 6 blunt and entangled by vines for 10 seconds); desert, sunbeam (a 10-cell line toward it, 15 fire and sight -50% for 3 seconds); humid, plague mist (radius 3, toxic buildup +15%). Upgraded from level 10: frost ×0.2 with a 50% chance to freeze for 3 seconds, roots and plague radius 5 with toxin +25%, sunbeam ×1.5 by day. Mana 2, cooldown 20 seconds. Circle of the Land, druid level 2.
LanguageData.LP_LD_NaturalRecovery.label: natural recovery
LanguageData.LP_LD_NaturalRecovery.description: Sit still for 5 seconds communing with the earth to recover half your max mana. Once per day. Circle of the Land, druid level 2.
LanguageData.LP_LD_Terraform.label: earth shaping
LanguageData.LP_LD_Terraform.description: Permanently reshape the terrain in radius 2 at a point within 20 cells (radius 3 from level 10) into the type picked with the "terrain" button: deep water (dig a lake), shallow water, marsh, mud, soil, rich soil, sand. Only changes natural ground: player-laid floors, cells with buildings / items / pawns, and special terrain like lava and propane lakes (Alpha Biomes) are left alone; plants on cells turned to water are washed away. Mana 2, cooldown 10 seconds. Circle of the Land, druid level 6.
LanguageData.LP_LD_TerraMode.label: earth shaping: terrain
LanguageData.LP_LD_TerraMode.description: Click the button to switch the terrain earth shaping creates: deep water → shallow water → marsh → mud → soil → rich soil → sand. No mana cost. Circle of the Land, druid level 6.
LanguageData.LP_LD_LandStride.label: land's stride
LanguageData.LP_LD_LandStride.description: Passive: no slowdown from terrain, snow or plants, can't be entangled by vines; plant work speed +20%. Circle of the Land, druid level 6.
LanguageData.LP_LD_NatureWard.label: nature's ward
LanguageData.LP_LD_NatureWard.description: Passive: immune to food poisoning and toxic buildup, immunity gain ×1.5; land's spell upgraded, earth shaping radius +1. Circle of the Land, druid level 10.
LanguageData.LP_LD_Sanctuary.label: nature's sanctuary
LanguageData.LP_LD_Sanctuary.description: Passive: attacks from animals (wild, manhunting, enemy) can't hurt you; while standing on natural ground (not floors), heal 1 every 4 seconds. Circle of the Land, druid level 14.
LanguageData.LP_SP_Halo.label: halo of spores
LanguageData.LP_SP_Halo.description: On / off: enemies within radius 2 take 3 × verdant power necrotic damage every 4 seconds (×1.5 with fungal plants nearby). While on, mana recovery is halved. Circle of Spores, druid level 2.
LanguageData.LP_SP_RotTouch.label: touch of rot
LanguageData.LP_SP_RotTouch.description: An adjacent enemy takes 8 × verdant power necrotic damage, and its wounds don't heal for 1 hour. Mana 1, cooldown 5 seconds. Circle of Spores, druid level 2.
LanguageData.LP_SP_Symbiotic.label: symbiotic entity
LanguageData.LP_SP_Symbiotic.description: For 1 hour: gain a shield of 4 × druid level, melee adds 4 × verdant power necrotic damage, halo of spores damage ×2. Mana 2, cooldown 1 hour. Circle of Spores, druid level 6.
LanguageData.LP_SP_Infestation.label: spreading spores
LanguageData.LP_SP_Infestation.description: Passive: when a humanlike enemy dies within 10 cells, 50% chance it sprouts fungus and stands up to fight for you for 1 day (no mental breaks, turns to rotting soil when time is up); its gear drops to the ground first. At most 4 per map. Circle of Spores, druid level 10.
LanguageData.LP_SP_FungalBody.label: fungal body
LanguageData.LP_SP_FungalBody.description: Passive: no bleeding, immune to toxins and fear, sharp damage taken ×0.75. Circle of Spores, druid level 14.
LanguageData.LP_ST_StarBolt.label: guiding bolt
LanguageData.LP_ST_StarBolt.description: One enemy within 24 cells takes 14 × verdant power radiant damage and is lit by starlight: the next damage it takes ×1.25. Free 2 + (druid level - 1) ÷ 4 times per day, then 1 mana each time. Passive "star map": research speed +10%; outdoors at night, druid spell power ×1.25. Cooldown 5 seconds. Circle of Stars, druid level 2.
LanguageData.LP_ST_StarryForm.label: starry form
LanguageData.LP_ST_StarryForm.description: Become the constellation picked with the "constellation" button for 1 hour: archer (fires an arrow at the nearest enemy within 15 cells every 4 seconds, 8 × verdant power radiant), chalice (heals the most injured ally within 6 cells for 4 × verdant power every 4 seconds), dragon (mind resistance +30%, pain shock threshold +30%). You can switch constellations mid-form. Mana 2, cooldown 2 hours. Circle of Stars, druid level 6.
LanguageData.LP_ST_FormMode.label: starry form: constellation
LanguageData.LP_ST_FormMode.description: Click the button to switch constellations: archer → chalice → dragon. No mana cost. Circle of Stars, druid level 6.
LanguageData.LP_ST_CosmicOmen.label: cosmic omen
LanguageData.LP_ST_CosmicOmen.description: Passive: draw an omen each day on waking. Weal: allies within 10 cells take ×0.9 damage; woe: enemies within 10 cells take ×1.1 damage. Circle of Stars, druid level 10.
LanguageData.LP_ST_FullOfStars.label: full of stars
LanguageData.LP_ST_FullOfStars.description: Passive: semi-transparent in starry form, damage taken ×0.5 (except psychic), walking unaffected by terrain. Circle of Stars, druid level 14.
LanguageData.LP_LF_Disciple.label: disciple of life
LanguageData.LP_LF_Disciple.description: Passive: cure wounds and mass cure wounds healing ×1.3; tend speed and tend quality +15%, surgery success +10%. Life Domain, cleric level 1.
LanguageData.LP_LF_Preserve.label: channel divinity: preserve life
LanguageData.LP_LF_Preserve.description: Allies within radius 6 with over half their health lost share 5 × cleric level healing, the most injured first, each healed back at most half their injuries. Channel Divinity 1, no divinity cost. Life Domain, cleric level 2.
LanguageData.LP_LF_BlessedHealer.label: blessed healer
LanguageData.LP_LF_BlessedHealer.description: Passive: each time you cast cure wounds or mass cure wounds, you also heal 2 + that spell's divinity cost. Life Domain, cleric level 6.
LanguageData.LP_LF_DivineStrike.label: divine strike: radiant
LanguageData.LP_LF_DivineStrike.description: Passive: the first weapon hit every 2 seconds adds 8 × divine power radiant damage (16 from level 14). Life Domain, cleric level 8.
LanguageData.LP_LF_Supreme.label: supreme healing
LanguageData.LP_LF_Supreme.description: Passive: healing spell amounts another ×1.5 (×1.95 in total). Life Domain, cleric level 17.
LanguageData.LP_LT_WardingFlare.label: warding flare
LanguageData.LP_LT_WardingFlare.description: Passive: when an enemy attacks you, spend one warding flare for a 50% chance (-5% per level the attacker is above you) to dazzle them into missing. Uses per day = Wisdom modifier (at least 1). Light Domain, cleric level 1.
LanguageData.LP_LT_Light.label: light
LanguageData.LP_LT_Light.description: Cantrip: make a cell within 20 cells glow for 1 day (light radius 6). No divinity cost, cooldown 5 seconds. Light Domain, cleric level 1.
LanguageData.LP_LT_Dawn.label: channel divinity: radiance of the dawn
LanguageData.LP_LT_Dawn.description: Dispel magical darkness within radius 6, reveal invisible enemies for 1 hour, and each enemy takes 10 × divine power + cleric level radiant damage (×2 against undead, fiends and mind flayers from level 6). Channel Divinity 1, no divinity cost. Light Domain, cleric level 2.
LanguageData.LP_LT_ImprovedFlare.label: improved warding flare
LanguageData.LP_LT_ImprovedFlare.description: Passive: warding flare also protects allies within 15 cells; radiance of the dawn ×2 against undead, fiends and mind flayers. Light Domain, cleric level 6.
LanguageData.LP_LT_Potent.label: potent spellcasting
LanguageData.LP_LT_Potent.description: Passive: divine strike (the cleric cantrip) damage + Wisdom modifier × 10%. Light Domain, cleric level 8.
LanguageData.LP_LT_Corona.label: corona of light
LanguageData.LP_LT_Corona.description: A 1-minute aura of dawnlight: enemies within radius 6 take 8 × divine power radiant damage every 4 seconds and sight -30%. Uses one Channel Divinity with no divinity cost if you have any left, otherwise divinity 3. Cooldown 10 seconds. Light Domain, cleric level 17.
LanguageData.LP_FG_Blessing.label: forge blessing
LanguageData.LP_FG_Blessing.description: Enchant the weapon in hand (or the best-armored piece of worn apparel if no weapon) +1 (up to +10); blessing another piece withdraws the +1 from the previous one. Passive: crafting and handiwork speed +10%. Once per day. Forge Domain, cleric level 1.
LanguageData.LP_FG_Artisan.label: channel divinity: artisan's blessing
LanguageData.LP_FG_Artisan.description: Spend 50 steel that isn't forbidden on the map to conjure an excellent-quality steel longsword, spear or mace at your feet (choose in a popup). Channel Divinity 1, no divinity cost. Forge Domain, cleric level 2.
LanguageData.LP_FG_Soul.label: soul of the forge
LanguageData.LP_FG_Soul.description: Passive: fire damage ×0.5; while wearing heavy armor (60%+ sharp armor), damage taken another ×0.9. Forge Domain, cleric level 6.
LanguageData.LP_FG_DivineStrike.label: divine strike: fire
LanguageData.LP_FG_DivineStrike.description: Passive: the first weapon hit every 2 seconds adds 8 × divine power fire damage (16 from level 14). Forge Domain, cleric level 8.
LanguageData.LP_FG_Saint.label: saint of forge and fire
LanguageData.LP_FG_Saint.description: Passive: immune to fire and burning; while wearing heavy armor, non-spell damage taken ×0.5 (replacing soul of the forge's ×0.9). Forge Domain, cleric level 17.
